thread:
Alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to finalize customer-facing comms and lock owners for action items. Who can take the status page wording + 72h summary?
Meera: I can draft the 72h customer summary. Plan is to include concise timeline + what we're doing to prevent recurrence.
Jordan: I'll take the status page copy. Want to avoid technical jargon — keep it 'service interruption' language.
Alex: Thanks. Also need a decision on RCA sharing: full internal RCA vs redacted public RCA vs refusal to share. Legal input needed?
Ryan: Legal flagged a few items we should redact (third-party vendor IDs, internal IPs). We can do a redacted public RCA + offer full RCA under NDA for affected enterprise customers.
Sara: For consistency, recommend a 2-tier approach: (1) public incident summary + redacted RCA snippet, (2) full RCA on request (NDA or customer contract).
Meera: Agreed. For the 72h summary I'll include a line: "We will provide a redacted technical summary within 72 hours and discuss deeper details with affected customers under existing agreements." Thoughts?
Jordan: That wording is good. Keep it neutral. Also add a short human impact line: "Some requests experienced higher latency and errors for approximately X hours; no data exfiltration."
Alex: Good. Can you post a statuspage snippet here once done? We'll use it for both status.redwood.ai and customer emails.
Jordan: Draft below — open to edits:
```
Status: Service disruption affecting inference API (region: us-west-2).
Impact: Increased latency and elevated error rates for text generation endpoints between 02:15–03:02 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated; traffic routed to fallback capacity. A redacted summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```
Sara: Suggest replacing "mitigated" with "service restored for most customers" to set expectations.
Jordan: Updated to:
```
Status: Partial outage affecting inference API (us-west-2).
Impact: Increased latency and errors for a subset of requests from 02:15–03:02 UTC.
Current status: Service restored for most customers; engineers are validating full recovery.
```
Alex: Good. Meera, timeline for the 72h summary? When can we publish?
Meera: I can have a draft by T+48h for internal review, T+70h for final redacted post to statuspage (to allow legal review).
Ryan: Legal will prioritize review once draft is in. Please tag me and include the raw timeline + logs pointer.
CustomerComms: I'll prep the customer email template; will mirror statuspage language and include CTA for affected customers to request the full RCA.
Sara: Action items tracker:
- Meera: Draft redacted 72h summary (due in 48h).
- Jordan: Statuspage copy + update incident page (due in 24h).
- Ryan: Legal review of redactions (due within 24h of draft).
- Alex: Confirm escalation for enterprise outreach (owner).
- CustomerComms: Prepare customer email + FAQ (due in 36h).
Jordan: Want to add a short FAQ entry about "What does redacted mean?" — one sentence.
CustomerComms: Will do. Also suggest adding a link to the postmortem once internal RCA is finalized.
Alex: We should also tag recurring incident pattern item: ops/ML infra to look for similar slow-tail latency events in last 90 days and flag if this is a pattern. Owner?
Meera: Ops can take that. I'll create a follow-up ticket: "Investigate recurring slow-tail latency events" and add to the postmortem action list.
Sara: Add recurrence detection to Optimize team checklist — suggested cadence: weekly incident pattern review.
Ryan: I'm okay with the 2-tier RCA approach. Legal suggests we include a short consent blurb for customers who request full RCA: "Full RCA available under existing confidentiality terms; contact support to initiate."
Alex: Good. For tracking, put all action items in the incident postmortem doc and set due dates + owners. We'll add a weekly reminder to the incident owners channel at T+7d.
Meera: I've created the ticket PRD-4721 and linked it in the postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PRD-4721 (will move to public link for redacted summary).
Jordan: I'll update the statuspage entry and ping ops-bot to publish when Meera confirms final wording.
IncidentBot: @Jordan Your statuspage update request queued. Publish window: 30 minutes.
CustomerComms: Draft email ready — sending to Alex + Ryan for approval now.
Alex: Approving once legal signs off on redactions. Ryan, can you reply with approval by EOD?
Ryan: I'll review and aim to sign off within 6 hours. If any problematic items, I'll flag them inline.
Sara: For transparency, let's include a short "what we're improving" list in the public summary: 1) improved routing fallbacks, 2) tighter throttling controls, 3) monitoring alerts tuned for slow-tail patterns.
Meera: Adding that. Also adding owner names and estimated completion quarters for each item.
Alex: Solid. Last thing — let's standardize the statuspage language template so we don't re-debate terms every time. Jordan/Sara, can you produce a single-line template and save to /templates/statuspage-incident-snippet?
Jordan: Will do. Draft template: "Status: [Short impact line]. Impact: [what users saw]. Current status: [mitigated/restored/ongoing]. Next steps: [what we'll do/patch ETA]."
Sara: Nice. I'll add a short examples doc and push to the docs repo.
Alex: Great work — owners, please update the postmortem doc with links to your deliverables and set the due dates. We'll reconvene if any blockers. :thumbsup:
Meera: Will update doc now and notify when draft is ready.
Jordan: Statuspage snippet posted and scheduled pending final sign-off.
Ryan: Legal review done — two redactions requested; Meera, see comments in the draft.
CustomerComms: Final email queued, will send immediately after Ryan's confirmation.
Alex: Closing thread — follow-ups tracked in the postmortem. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
